verdict.rationale: LM Studio exposes a REST API and CLI (lms) that covers core model management, chat, and serving (docs-8–14), and community feedback confirms the API/CLI is genuinely useful for real tool integration (comm-7, comm-17). However, some UI-only features like RAG document attachment, MCP server chat, and Bionic's agentic/voice capabilities have no documented API equivalent, and users explicitly wish for a fuller daemon/headless parity (comm-13, comm-19).
